answer: Because the timing is written down against the lotus challenge, the jetty audit can replay the nectar history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 80 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Each duplicate costs another 52 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
